## Shared types (`$defs`)

### `uint`

Unsigned integer within I-JSON's safe range. Type: integer 0..9007199254740991.

### `positive`

Positive integer within I-JSON's safe range. Type: integer 1..9007199254740991.

### `hex64`

64 lowercase hexadecimal digits. Type: string, length ≤ 64, `^[0-9a-f]{64}$`.

### `digest`

`sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits. Type: string, length ≤ 71, `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`.

### `bdf`

PCI address, `dddd:bb:dd.f`, lowercase. Type: string, length ≤ 12, `^[0-9a-f]{4}:[0-9a-f]{2}:[0-1][0-9a-f]\.[0-7]$`.

### `jsonPointer`

RFC 6901 JSON Pointer; "" is the root. Type: string, length ≤ 1024, `^(\|/(?:[^~/]\|~[01])*(?:/(?:[^~/]\|~[01])*)*)$`.

### `powerProfileName`

Named power profile, independently selected from serving profile. Type: string, length ≤ 32, `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$`.

### `powerRole`

Engine or indexed helper role. Type: string, length ≤ 32, `^(engine\|helper[0-9]+)$`.

Resolved power settings; an empty object means no writes. C++ `PowerSettings`.

| Path | Type | Required | Class | Radiance | Description |

| `$defs/powerSettings/power_cap_w` | integer 1.. |  |  |  | Board power cap in watts. |

### `powerPatch`

Nonempty role override of power settings. Every member of `powerSettings`, each optional; a present group is nonempty.

## Calibration keys

| Key | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `host_reserve.floor_mib` | `uint` | Smallest host reserve, MiB. |
| `host_reserve.total_fraction_ppm` | integer 0..<1000000 | Host reserve as a fraction of MemTotal, ppm. |
| `kv_backing_floor.fraction_ppm` | integer 0..<1000000 | KV backing floor as a fraction of the total KV ceiling, ppm (spec §5.2). |
| `checkpoint_share` | one of `"tier_first"`, `"want"`, `"floor"` | How checkpoint memory is shared with the KV tier. |
| `host_kv_tier.target_mib` | `uint` | Host KV tier target, MiB. |
| `host_ledger_margin.mib` | `uint` | Host memory the host ledger leaves unplanned beyond the reserve, for what the host loses between the manifest being written and the engine's own host-room check, MiB (amendment 11). |
| `handoff.max_rows` | `positive` | Largest transport batch size, qualified against engine dispatch capacity and row-batch A/Bs. |
| `handoff.small_rows` | `positive` | Small lane threshold, measured with workload-matched row shape A/Bs. |
| `handoff.gemv_large_rows` | `positive` | Large GEMV crossover, measured with workload-matched row shape A/Bs. |
| `handoff.moe_down_tile` | integer 0..2 | Chosen MoE downprojection tile mode, measured with correctness and speed A/Bs. |
| `handoff.histogram_period_s` | `positive` | Histogram sample period, measured with coverage/overhead and heat-age evidence. |
| `handoff.live_cadence_ns` | `positive` | Placement cadence, measured against histogram period, migration cost and settle windows. |
